verdict.rationale: Airweave publishes a reachable OpenAPI spec at docs.airweave.ai/openapi.json, and its docs describe searching collections through a single endpoint. They also show a programmatic client (client.source_connections.create) and reference the API directly in the webhooks docs, so the product can be driven through a documented public API. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: A collection is a group of different data sources that you can search using a single endpoint.
Instead of constantly polling the API, you register a webhook endpoint and Airweave pushes updates to you the moment they occur.
